lessons.title: Walk and look
lessons.controls:
W A S D   Walk
Mouse   Look
lessons.text: Practice with the shapes before building the engine. Walk a few steps with W, A, S and D. Move the mouse to look around. Take your time; the next instruction waits for you.

lessons.title: Pick up matching cubes
lessons.controls:
Aim + left click / E   Pick up one cube
Click a second blue cube   Carry both
lessons.text: Find the blue cubes on the nearby table. Aim at a cube and click to pick it up. Click a second cube to carry both. The inventory number shows how many matching parts you hold.

lessons.title: Fit a cube
lessons.controls:
Carry a cube
Aim at a visible matching ghost + click
lessons.text: Find a cube-shaped ghost on the practice board. Carry a cube, aim at the visible ghost and click to fit it. In Easy difficulty the position and rotation are handled for you.

lessons.title: Adjust the lift height
lessons.controls:
Hold the red lever + drag up / down
Or use Up / Down arrows
lessons.text: Find the red lever beside the practice board. Hold the left mouse button on its red grip and drag up or down. Release to stop the lift. Try changing the board height now.

actions.label: Raise or lower the practice board

lessons.title: Try the guides
lessons.controls:
H   Toggle ghost hints
V   Toggle the direction arrow
R   Replay this instruction
lessons.text: Press H to hide the ghost hints, then press H again to restore them. Press V to try the direction arrow, then press V again to turn it off. R replays the current voice line whenever you need it.

actions.label: Toggle hints off and back on
Toggle the arrow on and back off

lessons.title: Choose your workspace
lessons.controls:
Scan a clear, well-lit surface
Tap PLACE when ready
lessons.text: Allow camera access and scan a clear, well-lit surface. Tap Place when a surface is found. Set the practice shapes at a comfortable working height. The engine will use this workspace after practice.

lessons.title: Choose a cube, then fit it
lessons.controls:
Bottom cards   Choose a blue cube
Tap its visible ghost   Install
lessons.text: Choose a blue cube from the cards at the bottom. Tap a visible cube-shaped target on the practice board to fit it. A target hidden behind solid material must be viewed from another angle.

lessons.title: Turn the practice board
lessons.controls: One finger   Rotate
lessons.text: Drag with one finger to turn the practice board. Try rotating it until you can see the cube-shaped targets. Only the active build moves.

lessons.title: Try the help settings
lessons.controls:
SETTINGS   Volume / captions / hints / arrow
NEXT STEP   Automatic placement
lessons.text: Open Settings to find volume, captions, ghost hints and the direction arrow. Close settings to return to practice. Next Step fits the next component for you when you need help.

lessons.title: Quest 2: walk and turn
lessons.controls:
Left Touch stick   Walk
Right Touch stick left / right   Turn
lessons.text: On Meta Quest 2, use the left Touch-controller thumbstick to walk a few steps. Push the right thumbstick sideways to turn. Keep inside your safe play area.

lessons.title: Quest 2: fit a cube
lessons.controls:
Side grip   Hold a cube
Near visible ghost   Preview
Release side grip   Install
Point + trigger   Alternative placement
lessons.text: Point at a blue cube and hold the side grip button to carry it. Move the cube near a visible matching ghost to preview its fit. Move away to cancel. Release the side grip at the ghost to install it. Pointing at the ghost and pressing the trigger also places a held cube.

lessons.title: Adjust the lift height
lessons.controls:
Hold red lever   Move up / down
Release   Stop
lessons.text: Reach for the red lever with a Touch controller. Hold the side grip and move your controller up or down to adjust the practice board height. Release the grip to stop. Try moving the lift now.

lessons.title: Try the menus
lessons.controls:
Menu / Pause   Chapters and settings
Next   Automatic placement
lessons.text: Press the Menu button with three lines on the left Touch controller. Open settings or chapters, then return to practice. A on the right controller or X on the left installs the next part automatically.

lessons.title: Walk around the garage
lessons.controls:
Left joystick   Walk
Drag clear view   Look
lessons.text: Use the left joystick to walk a few steps. Drag on a clear part of the screen to look around. Practice with the shapes; each lesson waits until you have tried its control.

lessons.title: Carry a practice cube
lessons.controls:
Tap a cube   Pick up
Tap its visible ghost   Install
lessons.text: Tap a blue cube on the nearby table to pick it up. Tap a visible cube-shaped ghost on the practice board to fit it. Matching parts can be collected one at a time into the same inventory stack.

lessons.title: Adjust the lift height
lessons.controls:
Hold red lever   Move up / down
Release   Stop
lessons.text: Hold the red lift lever and drag up or down to change the practice board height. Release to stop. Try moving the lift now.

lessons.title: Explore how the engine works
lessons.controls:
INFO / TIMELINE   Inspect parts or play the build
ENGINE MOTION   Watch the moving mechanism
Audio and speed controls   Choose your playback
lessons.text: In the display experience, choose Info and Timeline to inspect a part or play the assembly sequence. Engine Motion shows the working mechanism and its four strokes. The audio toggle silences timeline descriptions when you want faster playback. Assembly speed controls how quickly parts enter their fitted positions.

lessons.title: Turn the practice board
lessons.controls: One finger   Rotate
lessons.text: Drag with one finger to turn the practice board. Try rotating it until you can see the cube-shaped targets. Only the active build moves.

lessons.title: Hard: move and rotate
lessons.controls:
Q   Carry / placement mode
T   Move / rotate tool
Right mouse + drag   Adjust the part
lessons.text: Hard difficulty needs the correct position and rotation. Hold a cube and press Q for placement mode. T switches between moving and rotating. Hold the right mouse button and drag to adjust the cube. Try both tools.

lessons.title: Quest 2: look and move
lessons.controls:
Walk inside your safe play area
Keep hands in view
lessons.text: Keep your hands where the Quest 2 cameras can see them. Look around, then walk a little inside your safe play area. The practice shapes let you try the controls before building the engine.

actions.label: Move safely in your play area

lessons.title: Take and fit a cube
lessons.controls:
Near cube   Pinch or close hand
Near visible ghost   Preview
Open hand   Install
lessons.text: Reach for a blue cube. Pinch or close your hand to take it, and keep that gesture while moving. Bring the cube near a visible matching ghost. Move away to cancel the preview. Open your hand at the ghost to install it.

lessons.title: Adjust the lift height
lessons.controls:
Hold red lever   Move up / down
Release   Stop
lessons.text: Reach for the red lift lever. Pinch or close your hand around it, then move your hand up or down to adjust the practice board height. Open your hand to stop. Try moving the lift now.

lessons.title: Try the menus
lessons.controls:
Menu / Pause   Chapters and settings
Next   Automatic placement
lessons.text: Point at Menu on your left wrist panel and pinch. Open settings or chapters, then return to practice. Next on the wrist panel installs the next part automatically when you need help.

lessons.title: Sprint, jump and crouch
lessons.controls:
Shift + walk   Sprint
Space   Jump
Ctrl / C   Crouch
lessons.text: Hold Shift while walking to sprint. Press Space to jump, then hold Control or C to crouch. Try each movement before continuing.

lessons.title: Drop the cubes
lessons.controls:
G   Drop every held copy
Pick the cubes up again when you are ready
lessons.text: Press G to drop the cubes. Both copies fall separately. Pick up a cube again for the placement practice.

lessons.title: Medium: move the held cube
lessons.controls:
Q   Carry / placement mode
T   Move / rotate tool
Right mouse + drag   Adjust the part
lessons.text: Medium difficulty needs placement mode. Hold a cube and press Q to enter it. Press T to try the move tool, then hold the right mouse button and drag to move the cube. The final rotation aligns automatically.

lessons.title: Fit the aligned cube
lessons.controls:
Placement mode   Aim at its visible ghost + click
Q   Return to carry mode if you need another cube
lessons.text: Bring the cube close to a matching ghost on the practice board. Match its position and rotation, then aim at the visible target and click to fit it.

lessons.title: Turn the practice board over
lessons.controls:
Red FLIP button / F   Turn the active lift
Left / Right arrows   Choose a lift
lessons.text: Press the red Flip button beside the practice board, or press F. Wait while the hatch opens and the board turns below the floor. The same control turns an engine workpiece when a fitting step needs it.

lessons.title: Chapters, pause and settings
lessons.controls:
Tab   Chapters
Esc   Pause / settings
Hold Alt   Use the guide buttons
N   Auto-install next part
lessons.text: Tab opens the chapter cards. Escape opens pause and settings, including volume, captions and difficulty. Open either menu and return to practice. N can fit the next part automatically if you get stuck.

lessons.title: Try movement buttons
lessons.controls:
Sprint   Move faster
Jump   Hop
Crouch   Lower your view
lessons.text: Try the Sprint button while moving, then tap Jump and Crouch. You can tap objects directly to interact; you do not have to aim a crosshair.

lessons.title: Turn the board over
lessons.controls: Touch FLIP / point and select   Turn over
lessons.text: Press the red Flip button beside the practice board. Wait for the hatch to open and the board to turn, then come back up. The same control turns an engine workpiece when needed.

lessons.title: Try the menus
lessons.controls:
Menu / Pause   Chapters and settings
Next   Automatic placement
lessons.text: Open Pause or Chapters, then return to practice. Settings contains volume, captions, difficulty and guide toggles. Next Step can install a part automatically when you need help.

lessons.title: Quest 2: teleport
lessons.controls:
Right stick forward   Aim at clear floor
Release the stick   Travel
lessons.text: Push the right Touch-controller thumbstick forward to aim a teleport arc at clear floor. Release the stick when the landing marker is valid. Try one teleport now.

lessons.title: Turn the board over
lessons.controls: Touch FLIP / point and select   Turn over
lessons.text: Press the red Flip button beside the practice board. Wait for the hatch to open and the board to turn, then come back up. The same control turns an engine workpiece when needed.

lessons.title: Travel with your wrist controls
lessons.controls:
Wrist TELEPORT   Point and pinch
Point at clear floor + pinch   Travel
lessons.text: Point at Teleport on your left wrist panel and pinch. Point your right hand at clear floor and pinch again when the landing marker is valid. Try one teleport now.

lessons.title: Turn the board over
lessons.controls: Touch FLIP / point and select   Turn over
lessons.text: Press the red Flip button beside the practice board. Wait for the hatch to open and the board to turn, then come back up. The same control turns an engine workpiece when needed.

lessons.title: Move and zoom
lessons.controls:
Two fingers   Move across view
Pinch   Zoom
lessons.text: Drag with two fingers to move the practice board across the view. Pinch your fingers together or apart to zoom. Try both gestures before continuing.

actions.label: Move the board with two fingers

lessons.title: Move and zoom
lessons.controls:
Two fingers   Move across view
Pinch   Zoom
lessons.text: Drag with two fingers to move the practice board across the view. Pinch your fingers together or apart to zoom. Try both gestures before continuing.

actions.label: Move the board with two fingers

lessons.title: Finish the practice board
lessons.controls: Fit the remaining cubes, gold cylinder and purple ball
lessons.text: Fit the remaining shapes into their matching targets on the practice board. Take as long as you need. The engine chapter starts after the board is complete.

lessons.title: Finish the practice board
lessons.controls: Fit the remaining cubes, gold cylinder and purple ball
lessons.text: Fit the remaining shapes into their matching targets on the practice board. Take as long as you need. The engine chapter starts after the board is complete.

lessons.text: Fit the remaining shapes into their matching targets on the practice board. Take as long as you need. The engine chapter starts after the board is complete.

lessons.text: Fit the remaining shapes into their matching targets on the practice board. Take as long as you need. The engine chapter starts after the board is complete.

lessons.title: Fit the positioned cube
lessons.controls:
Placement mode   Aim at its visible ghost + click
Q   Return to carry mode if you need another cube
lessons.text: Move the cube close to a matching ghost on the practice board. Aim at the visible target and click to fit it. Medium difficulty aligns the final rotation for you.
